To determine how many of the other planets orbit the Sun in the same direction as Earth, we can look at the orbital characteristics of the planets in our solar system:

1. There are eight planets in our solar system: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune.
2. All eight planets orbit the Sun in the prograde direction (counter-clockwise when viewed from above the Sun's North Pole). 
3. Although Venus and Uranus have retrograde rotation (they spin on their axes in the opposite direction to most other planets), Venus still orbits the Sun in the same prograde direction as Earth. In fact, *every* planet in our solar system revolves around the Sun in the same direction.
4. Therefore, out of the 7 *other* planets besides Earth, all 7 of them orbit in the same direction as Earth.

Final answer: D
